reasons.action: The brief requests the action of a lighthouse keeper lighting the lamp in a storm; with no reference or director note, action is request-governed.
reasons.medium: No visual reference is attached and the medium decision is no_reference, so there is no observed rendering medium to preserve; medium is request-governed.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference supplies observed clothing, and no director note resolves it, so wardrobe is request-governed.
reasons.lighting: No reference lighting is supplied; the storm setting alone is scene context and does not override a reference, but with none present lighting is request-governed.
reasons.framing: No reference or director note supplies camera composition; the explicit 16:9 aspect is canvas ratio rather than a framing instruction, so framing remains request-governed by default.
reasons.palette: No reference palette is supplied and no director note resolves it, so palette is request-governed.
